description: Review and, where appropriate, update the address recorded in Aadhaar after a move.
why_relevant: A permanent move can make the address in Aadhaar outdated. UIDAI provides an address update path for a changed address.
process: Use the official UIDAI/myAadhaar route or an Aadhaar Enrolment/Update Centre. Exact document eligibility should be checked against the current UIDAI supporting-document list.

requirements.description: UIDAI requires supporting proof of address for address update; exact accepted documents must be checked in the current official list.

dependencies.dependency_description: A valid address-proof document may support this and other address-linked services.

description: Shift an existing electoral-roll entry to the new ordinary residence.
why_relevant: ECI says an elector who has shifted residence should use Form 8 for shifting residence to the new place.
process: Use the official Voter Service Portal/Form 8 route and provide the requested new-residence information and address proof.

requirements.description: Form 8 guidance lists acceptable address-proof categories; use the current official form/guidelines.

dependencies.dependency_description: Address proof can support the residence-shifting request.

department: Ministry of Road Transport & Highways / Parivahan
description: Review the registered vehicle address and use the official Vahan process where an address change is applicable.
why_relevant: A permanent change of residence can make the address recorded against the vehicle registration outdated.
process: Use the official Vahan/Parivahan service and follow the state/RTO-specific workflow. Exact documents, fees and processing steps vary by service configuration and must be verified on the official portal.

requirements.description: Have the relevant vehicle/RC information available; exact supporting documents should be verified for the applicable RTO workflow.

dependencies.dependency_description: Address proof may be requested depending on the applicable workflow.

department: Ministry of Road Transport & Highways / Parivahan
description: Review the address associated with the driving licence after relocation.
why_relevant: Parivahan provides an online Change of Address service on Sarathi, subject to the applicable state/service configuration.
process: Use Sarathi Parivahan, select the state and Driving Licence services, then select Change of Address where available. Exact document and RTO requirements must be verified.

requirements.description: The official FAQ says the applicant enters Driving Licence number and date of birth to access services.

dependencies.dependency_description: Address proof may be required depending on the state/RTO workflow.

department: Department of Food & Public Distribution / NFSA
description: Review portability and destination-state arrangements for eligible food-security benefits after relocation.
trigger_conditions: Permanent move AND receives government benefits
why_relevant: NFSA's One Nation One Ration Card framework supports portability of food-grain entitlements for eligible beneficiaries, while state-level administration still matters.
process: Check the official NFSA/Mera Ration information and the relevant state food portal for the current portability and beneficiary-record process.

requirements.description: Use the current official NFSA or state portal to check the beneficiary record and applicable process.

description: Review address and jurisdiction-related PAN records after a permanent move.
why_relevant: A permanent move can affect address-linked tax records and, when moving between jurisdictions, PAN jurisdiction/JAO may need review.
process: Review the Income Tax e-Filing portal and Know Your JAO information. The exact PAN/address update or jurisdiction process depends on the record and should be verified with the official portal.

requirements.description: Keep PAN details and current address information available for the applicable official process.

dependencies.dependency_description: Address proof may be relevant to address-linked tax records; verify the current official requirement.
